#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

vector<LL> powers(18);

LL compute(LL num, int position) {
    LL count = num / powers[position];
    if (num % powers[position] == 0)
        return position * count;
    LL option1 = position * count + compute(num % powers[position], position - 1);
    LL option2 = position * (count + 1) + compute(powers[position] - (num % powers[position]), position - 1);
    return min(option1, option2);
}

int main() {
    powers[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= 17; ++i) {
        powers[i] = powers[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    LL number;
    cin >> number;
    cout << compute(number, 17);
    return 0;
}
